title: Expose an intended JavaScript callback with the right visibility
goal: Make a deliberately exposed browser-to-.NET instance callback public, call its declared JSInvokable identifier, and release the object reference when the component leaves.

selectionNotes: Click Read instrument: expect Level 137 cm. Direct real-JS AcceptLevel(138) returns Level 138 cm. Negative input and calling ReceiveLevel instead of AcceptLevel both reject. Toggle the panel off: its disposal count becomes 1 and the saved JS proxy rejects further invocations. The private before control reports Callback unavailable. RC2 reports BL0015 before and none after.
The fixes are valid on .NET 10; only the diagnostic is new in the measured .NET 11 analyzer. No SDK-only older-target analyzer route, package backport or additional .NET 10 foundation is advertised.
Interactive Server with prerender disabled is the executed route. No WASM, static SSR callback, Hybrid, AOT/trimming, arbitrary concurrency, performance or GA execution is established.
